display: Workspace-only Xvfb with TCP disabled; separate displays for concurrent captures
scenario: Actual showroom battlefield, seed 712, day, map size 1024; spawned Slammer destroyed through Vehicle.take_damage(max_hp * 3, null). After build forces the host cook-off flag. Main has no detached-turret feature.
sequence: Main close (5 seconds), after close (5 seconds), after at gameplay distance (5 seconds). Destruction at one second into each segment. Captured simulation time plays at normal speed; no time acceleration. Close comparison uses identical camera, seed, lighting, preset and timing.
scope: Real engine/gameplay destruction, not a mock. This clip demonstrates turret motion, settling and camera readability; it is not proof of replay compatibility. Separate actual gameplay recording seek/reopen and host/client tests pass.
limits: Software capture is not a performance measurement. This published Compatibility clip does not establish Forward+ parity or hardware performance. Separate renderer checks are reported in the PR. Earlier appearance sheets are retained with their original provenance.

verification.shutdown_diagnostics: Both main and the PR log renderer resource-cleanup errors after the motion-complete marker. These baseline teardown diagnostics remain unresolved; they are not a clean-shutdown claim.
